messages.text: Hi, i need to open an RMA for my Oder Shop····. On my Mail i get no response jet.
Used the store-orders skill
Used the customer-care skill

Sorry about the silence on email. RMAs go through one intake, and that's the fastest route: fill in the form here and you'll get a return label back, https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform . Processing takes up to 10 days once the unit reaches the warehouse.

One thing I have to ask: was the unit ever overclocked or modified? That's not covered by warranty.

What's it doing, exactly? If it's a dead PSU, we can send just the power supply instead of the whole unit going back.
hi, i took it out of the box and some chips are brocken on the board. the miner was not on.

That's a dead-on-arrival, not something you should try to fix. Put it on the RMA form with photos of the broken chips and the box: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Put Shop···· as the order number. A return label comes back to you, and processing runs up to 10 days after it lands at the warehouse.

Don't power it on in that state.

If you tell me the postcode ····name on the order, I can check what's on it and make sure the RMA matches.
Order: Shop···· ?
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)
Yes, that's the one. To pull it up I need one detail that matches it: the postcode ···· to, the name on the order, or the email you used. Whichever is easiest.

Postcode: ····
Name: Rainer B.
Looked something up in Shopify
Handed to the team · DOA unit on a delivered order, plus an unanswered support email; RMA needs a lab

Got it, Rainer, that matches: Shop····, one Bitfortun BS-2 (10TH/s), delivered to (address hidden).

Since it arrived broken and was never powered on, it's a clear warranty case. Fill in the RMA form with photos of the board and the box, order number Shop····: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

I've also put your case in front of the team so your email doesn't sit again. They're offline now and pick it up today at 10am ET, and you'll get the reply at (email hidden)
thx. i just send you the RMA. But i was not ask for photos in the form.

No problem, the form doesn't ask for them. Just keep the photos on your phone, clear shots of the damaged chips and the packaging. When the team replies about the RMA you can send them straight back in that email thread, and they'll have everything they need for the label.

Nothing else for you to do right now. Keep the unit and the box as they are until the label arrives.
thx
Used the chat-interview skill
Ran dossier.py (chat-interview skill)
Before you go, one thing: were you planning to add a second miner next to the BS-2, or was this one meant to stand on its own?
i have some bitaxe/nerdqaxe runnig. i plan maybe to replace them with newer miners in the futur
What would push you to retire them, the hashrate, the power draw, or the noise?
the bitaxe is running. the nerdqaxe has some issuse with the VRAMs and is not stable. i have pv and plan maybe a bigger pv miner
Good to know. How much surplus do you usually have at midday from the PV, in watts? That decides whether a 400 W class unit fits or whether you stay smaller.
400 in the night and 2000 in the day
Read the bsb b30 page

That's a nice profile. Your 400 W at night lines up almost exactly with one Harlo B30: 30 TH/s at 360 to 450 W, $899, currently pre-sale shipping October 30. Midday you'd have headroom for a second unit or a Magic Miner 40T alongside it.

One thing for Germany: it ships from the US, so the price is the unit only and 21% import VAT plus any duty is charged on delivery.

Let's get the BS-2 sorted first. Happy to run the numbers for your rate whenever you want.
